metadata.title: Ava for Reddit – A Modern, Native Reddit Client for iOS
metadata.description: Ava is a fast, clean, and fully native Reddit client for iOS, focused on performance, privacy, and a distraction-free experience.

hero.headline: Ava for Reddit <super>(beta)</super>
hero.subheadline: Ava is a <highlighted>fully native Reddit client for iOS</highlighted>, inspired by the <highlighted>best of Apollo</highlighted> and built from the ground up with <highlighted>Swift and SwiftUI</highlighted>. Every detail is handcrafted to feel fast, clean, and <highlighted>unmistakably iOS</highlighted>. Ava focuses on what matters most: speed, privacy, deep customizability, and a polished user experience <highlighted>without tracking, data collection, or compromises<dataCollectionLink>1</dataCollectionLink>.</highlighted>

compatibility.headline: Available on:
compatibility.footer: Minimum supported version is 26 and newer

feature1.headline: Your Reddit, Your Way
feature1.description:
Customize what other apps won't let you touch. Pick your style, tweak post spacing and padding, hide voting buttons if they're in your way. Want subreddit info at the top? Bottom? Done. Switch between full and compact styles whenever you feel like it.



Filter out the noise: block users completely, filter by keywords in titles or flairs, hide entire subreddits from your feeds. See only what you want to see.

feature2.headline: Built for People
feature2.description:
Generous spacing, bigger inline media, colored depth indicators so you never lose track of comment threads. Tap, hold, reply, share as an image or move your floating Skip Comment button. It just works the way you'd expect it to.



Missing TL;DR? Ava includes Post Summaries2 feature leveraging on-device model so you get summaries fast and free while keeping them private!

feature3.headline: Designed for iPad
feature3.description: Not just stretched, <highlighted>properly designed for iPad</highlighted>. A true <highlighted>two-column layout</highlighted> with a sidebar for subreddits and a focused detail view for feeds, posts, and comments. Full <highlighted>adaptive layout</highlighted> support, balanced spacing, and scaling that feel native on larger displays. <highlighted>Ava adapts to the canvas, not the other way around.</highlighted>

feature4.headline: Duo Ready
feature4.description: Fully compatible with your new iPhone Duo. <highlighted>Closed, opened, half-opened, portrait or landscape</highlighted>. Ava just natively adapts to all of them, whether you want <highlighted>compact, content-centric look</highlighted> on your outer display or <highlighted>rich content</highlighted> on your inner display.

homepage.notice: Ava is in <bold>active development</bold> and <bold>is not open-source (for now)</bold>. I am currently waiting for a follow-up on my API usage terms request to Reddit. Until then, the <highlighted>TestFlight link stays disabled</highlighted>.

disclaimers.dataCollection: <sup>1</sup> For development and debug purposes, Ava collects <highlighted>anonymous</highlighted> crash reports and some network failures reports. Data are <highlighted>anonymized before leaving your device</highlighted>, URLs, queries and bodies are stripped from HTTP requests. <highlighted>No Reddit data ever leave your device.</highlighted> More information regarding data collection can be found in <highlighted><policy>Privacy Policy</policy></highlighted>.
disclaimers.modelAvailability: <sup>2</sup> Post Summaries are subject to on-device model availability and are only available on devices with Apple Intelligence support.
